## Profile-driven subagent fixes

- **Children show who they are.** The sidebar row, the inspector, and the `agent_spawn` tool header now show `@agentId — label` for `mistrjirka/pi-subagent` children, instead of the bare profile name or the raw tool name.
- **Context usage is real.** A profiled child's context-window usage comes from its own session's newest assistant turn and renders as `used / limit` (for example `168K / 1M`). Until the model catalogue is warm it falls back to a plain token count, never to `starting…`.
- **"Last activity" is honest.** Freshness comes from the child session's newest progress rather than the extension's ~200 ms heartbeat, so profiled rows no longer read `unknown`.
- **Restarts no longer resurrect finished children.** A profiled run counts as live only while its heartbeat is fresh (2 minutes) and its `status.json` still exists — the extension removes that control directory when the hosting Pi process exits. Previously every child from an earlier run appeared alive after a restart.
- **Abandoned runs say so.** A child whose heartbeat has stopped is reported as `stale` rather than `running`, and the subagent selector groups it separately from active and finished runs. It is never reported as a fabricated success.
- **Long sessions stay cheap.** Child session snapshots are memoized by path, modification time, and size, so a large transcript is not re-read on every sidebar render.

## Subagent notifications

- **Completion notices are compact.** A `subagent-notification` in the chat is a bounded card — identity, status, model and usage, a one-line result preview with an `N more lines` hint, and the session path. Previously the entire JSON payload, including a result capped at 2000 lines / 50 KB, was dumped into the transcript and could fill half the screen.

## Conversation tabs

- **The first close button works.** The initial conversation tab rendered a `×` as soon as a second tab existed, but the close handler ignored that tab, so the first close button a user ever saw did nothing. Any tab can now be closed while more than one tab is open; the last remaining tab still cannot be closed.

## Compatibility

- Existing `pi-subagents` workflow, mission, transcript, and control handling is unchanged, including pause/resume/steer/stop. All legacy subagent tests still pass.
- The two subagent runtimes remain alternatives, not a combined stack: do not enable both at the same time.

## Validation

- PiTTy `npm run typecheck` passed.
- Focused tabs/subagent/UI suite: **208 passed, 0 failed**.
- Complete local suite (`npm run check`): **401 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed**.
